architectural_notes: Enquiry page access is restricted via email-based authorization (allowlist of permitted email addresses).
known_issues: Advnitin1404@gmail.com is still unable to access the enquiry page (user reports issue persists).

existing_features.title: Update the enquiries dashboard UI to handle missing/incorrect user profile email: if the caller is authenticated but their user profile is missing or has an empty email, show a "Complete Profile" form (name + email) that saves via saveCallerUserProfile, then re-check authorization and load enquiries when authorized.

Improve the "Access Denied" state on the enquiries dashboard to clearly indicate why access was denied by showing (a) whether isCallerAdmin is true/false and (b) the current saved profile email value (or "not set") so the admin can self-diagnose setup issues.
Add a React Query mutation hook to save the caller user profile (calling saveCallerUserProfile) and use it from the enquiries dashboard profile form.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix admin authorization so the enquiries dashboard is accessible to the user with email Advnitin1404@gmail.com by making the backend authorized-admin email comparison case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant (trim + lowercase on both stored profile email and authorized email).
